analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 40.2 continues to hover in neutral territory, and the MACD histogram remains negative at -1.2736, showing a worsening trend. Volume ratio below 1 for 5 consecutive days indicates a lack of buying pressure. The price has entered a consolidation phase after 20 consecutive days of negative closes. At $271.09, 42.6% below its 52-week high, the stock is in a period of reduced volatility. ADX at 24.6 suggests an early stage of trend formation with no clear direction. With no strong signals for either buying or selling, a wait-and-see approach is maintained.
